responsibility: Collects internal rs6000-only declarations shared across the backend implementation files. It defines central data structures such as rs6000_stack_t, declares cross-file helpers for prologue/epilogue generation, ABI and builtin handling, argument passing, split-stack support, and pass entry points, and provides small shared inline utilities, making it the private coordination header that ties rs6000.cc, rs6000-call.cc, rs6000-logue.cc, and related sources together.
